goal: decision-models S3 (BR-DEC-5; #204 slice 2b). A maintainer can point a profile at Jev (TypeSafe System One) and get the same decision envelope as from Clef. Delegated choices: a jev profile is {kind, api_key_env, base_url?, timeout_ms?, context_window?} with base_url defaulting to https://api.typesafe.ai; scripts/decision-model/providers/jev.ts POSTs the Clef choice request body to <base_url>/v1/systemone with Authorization: Bearer <api_key_env value> and parses the Clef choice result shape. These facts come from third-party pages and are unverified against TypeSafe's reference; the source used is recorded in the A14 fixture README, and a mismatch surfaces as unavailable, never as a decision. Choice questions only.

acceptance.assertion: In tests/decision-model.test.ts, decide() with a jev profile and a recording fetch sends exactly one POST to https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone (or the profile's base_url) whose body equals the Clef adapter's body for the same point and state and whose Authorization header is Bearer plus the api_key_env value, and returns a decision envelope with per-option probabilities summing to 1 within 1e-6 and provider kind jev.

In tests/decision-model.test.ts, a jev profile returns unavailable without a decision for each of: api_key_env unset (credential_missing, no fetch call); HTTP 401 (provider_error naming status 401); a body missing the choice result (invalid_response); probabilities naming an option outside the point's options (invalid_response); a fetch that exceeds timeout_ms (provider_error); and no error detail contains the credential value. A jev profile with an unknown key or a non-string api_key_env is config_invalid.
In tests/decision-eval-a14.test.ts, scripts/decision-eval/a14/run.ts with a jev profile bound to a14_pr_comment_triage and a replaced fetch writes a report whose provider_kind is jev.
